Nen-Unawakened.name: Nen-Unawakened
Nen-Unawakened.description: Your aura nodes remain sealed. You cannot access Nen in any form, and your aura pool stays dormant near zero. This state marks those unaware of Nen's existence, common before Hunter training or awakening. Your potential lies dormant, waiting for the catalyst that will open your inner gates.
Nen-Unawakened.quirk: Aura nodes are closed and sealed. The character cannot use any Nen ability, skill, or technique—Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu, all are beyond reach. Aura bar remains near zero. A narrative trigger (forced aura awakening, guided Ten initiation, or violent Nen exposure) can swap this trait for Nen Initiate in play.

Nen Initiate.name: Nen Initiate
Nen Initiate.description: Your aura nodes have been opened; you have learned the foundational technique of Ten. You can now maintain a steady aura state and hold basic Nen energy, though advanced applications remain beyond your reach. This is the threshold where the invisible world reveals itself.
Nen Initiate.quirk: Aura +30, Ten skill +2. You can hold Ten (the default meditative aura state). You are newly baptized in Nen and vulnerable to advanced practitioners, but the door has opened.

Nen Practitioner.name: Nen Practitioner
Nen Practitioner.description: You have mastered the foundational Nen techniques and are combat-capable. You can hold Ten reliably, apply Ren for amplified output, and channel basic Hatsu. You are a trained Nen user—not yet elite, but formidable in the eyes of the untrained.
Nen Practitioner.quirk: Aura +60, Ten +4, Ren +3, Hatsu +2. You can execute basic Nen combat and maintain sustained aura applications. Ren drains aura per turn in prolonged use; Hatsu abilities draw 10–20% per activation.

Nen Adept.name: Nen Adept
Nen Adept.description: You have refined your Nen to professional mastery. Your aura is vast, your control exquisite, and advanced applications like Gyo and Shu respond to your will. You are among the world's elite—a hunter of legendary standing capable of feats the average person cannot fathom.
Nen Adept.quirk: Aura +100, Ten +6, Ren +5, Hatsu +4, Zetsu +3. You can execute sophisticated aura techniques: Gyo (aura sight), Shu (object coating), In (concealment), and Ken (full defensive guard). One advanced-application ability is unlocked at character creation (chosen from Tier A: Gyo, Shu, In, Ken, Ko, or Ryu).

Nen Master.name: Nen Master
Nen Master.description: You stand among the world's apex—a living legend whose aura is nearly bottomless and whose command of Nen transcends mortal limitation. You wield advanced applications as easily as breathing and can shape reality itself through your Hatsu. Few walk this earth; fewer still reach this pinnacle.
Nen Master.quirk: Aura +150, Ten +8, Ren +7, Hatsu +6, Zetsu +5. You command all Tier A applications flawlessly: Gyo, Shu, In, Ken, Ko, Ryu, and En (aura field). Two advanced-application abilities are unlocked at character creation. Your Hatsu is legendary; your limitations are self-imposed.

Enhancer.name: Enhancer
Enhancer.description: Your Water Divination showed the water overflowing—the sign of an Enhancer. You possess raw physical prowess and the ability to amplify yourself and objects beyond their normal limits. Your Nen flows easily into your body and surroundings, making you the strongest combatant on any field. The hexagon rule governs your reach: your enhancement is full-strength in itself and adjacent categories (Transmutation, Emission), strong in distant categories (Conjuration, Manipulation), and nearly impossible in Specialization.
Enhancer.quirk: Enhancement +4 (native), Transmutation +3, Emission +3, Conjuration +2, Manipulation +2, Specialization +0. Your Nen specializes in amplification of self and objects. Transmutation and Emission are within reach; Conjuration and Manipulation are harder; Specialization techniques are nearly impossible to perform and require enormous effort. The hexagon dictates your efficiency: opposite-category Hatsu (e.g., a Conjurer's trap) suffers visible strain if you attempt it.

Transmuter.name: Transmuter
Transmuter.description: Your Water Divination showed the taste changing—a Transmuter's sign. You can alter the properties of your aura and objects, reshaping Nen into new forms and functions. Your techniques flow with creativity and deception; you bend the rules of reality itself. Adjacent categories (Enhancement, Conjuration) yield readily to your will; distant ones (Emission, Specialization) require great effort; opposite-category Nen (Manipulation) resists your touch severely.
Transmuter.quirk: Transmutation +4 (native), Enhancement +3, Conjuration +3, Emission +2, Specialization +1, Manipulation +1. Your Nen transforms and reshapes. Enhancement and Conjuration come naturally; Emission and Specialization are taxing; Manipulation is hostile to your nature and nearly impossible without exhaustion. The hexagon enforces this: you are a creative liar, and your Nen reflects that flexibility—except where it refuses.

Conjurer.name: Conjurer
Conjurer.description: Your Water Divination revealed impurities—the mark of a Conjurer. You summon matter from nothing, creating objects and weapons that manifest your will. Your Nen is precise and analytical; you are meticulous and high-strung, crafting tools with obsessive care. Transmutation and Specialization respond to your summons; Enhancement and Manipulation are within range; Emission lies distant; you alone among categories touch Specialization easily.
Conjurer.quirk: Conjuration +4 (native), Transmutation +3, Specialization +2, Enhancement +2, Manipulation +2, Emission +1. Your Nen creates real objects from aura. Transmutation flows from your conjurations naturally; Specialization is uniquely accessible to you (forbidden to pure Enhancers/Emitters); Enhancement and Manipulation are taxing; Emission is nearly impossible. You are analytical and precise—your Nen reflects that obsessive control.

Manipulator.name: Manipulator
Manipulator.description: Your Water Divination showed the leaf moving—a Manipulator's sign. You command and control external objects and forces through pure will, bending them to your logic. Your Nen is invisible and precise; you are argumentative and cerebral, turning your opponent's own strength against them. Emission and Specialization yield to your control; Conjuration and Enhancement are manageable; Transmutation resists; you alone among categories touch Specialization easily.
Manipulator.quirk: Manipulation +4 (native), Emission +3, Specialization +2, Conjuration +2, Enhancement +2, Transmutation +1. Your Nen controls external forces and objects. Emission flows from your commands; Specialization is uniquely accessible to you (forbidden to pure Enhancers/Emitters); Conjuration and Enhancement are difficult; Transmutation is nearly impossible. You are logical and stubborn—your Nen works through pure reason and will, but cannot shapeshift.

Emitter.name: Emitter
Emitter.description: Your Water Divination showed the color changing—an Emitter's mark. You project your aura outward as waves, beams, and blasts, striking your enemies from a distance with raw power. Your Nen is aggressive and impatient; you are hot-blooded and bold, charging forward where others calculate. Enhancement and Manipulation respond readily; Transmutation and Specialization are within reach; Conjuration lies distant; you cannot easily conjure.
Emitter.quirk: Emission +4 (native), Enhancement +3, Manipulation +3, Transmutation +2, Conjuration +1, Specialization +1. Your Nen projects outward as force and energy. Enhancement and Manipulation flow naturally from your projection; Transmutation and Specialization are possible but effortful; Conjuration is nearly impossible (you cannot create lasting objects easily). You are impatient and aggressive—your Nen reflects your hot-blooded nature.

Specialist.name: Specialist
Specialist.description: Your Water Divination showed something else entirely happening—the rarest and most mysterious sign. You do not fit the hexagon. Your Nen follows no predictable pattern; you are an individualist whose power is singular and often inexplicable. All other categories are equally distant to you; you are truly alone on the wheel. Your Hatsu is unique by definition, and you alone can touch techniques forbidden to other categories.
Specialist.quirk: Specialization +4 (native), Conjuration +3, Manipulation +3, Transmutation +2, Emission +2, Enhancement +1. Your Nen breaks the hexagon rules. You alone can combine Conjuration and Manipulation freely (other categories cannot); you are equally awkward in all other categories. You are an individualist—your Nen is yours alone, following laws no one else understands. Other Nen users cannot easily predict or counter your techniques.

Undivined.name: Undivined
Undivined.description: You have not yet undergone Water Divination. Your Nen category remains unknown—even to you. Your potential is uncharted, your strength untested against the glass and water that reveals all Nen users' truths. In play, the moment you perform or witness Divination, the universe will answer.
Undivined.quirk: This character's Nen category has not been revealed. They carry no category skill modifiers. When they perform Water Divination in play (a narrative moment or a semantic trigger), a trigger swaps this trait for the appropriate category trait and narrates the divination result. Until then, they are a mystery—even to themselves.

Developing Hatsu (Enhancement).name: Developing Hatsu (Enhancement)
Developing Hatsu (Enhancement).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around enhancement and amplification. You are learning to channel your Nen into strengthening yourself, objects, or targeted forces. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Enhancement).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Enhancement—amplifying strength, durability, or external objects. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Transmutation).name: Developing Hatsu (Transmutation)
Developing Hatsu (Transmutation).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around transmutation and property-alteration. You are learning to reshape your aura into new forms and functions—changing its nature, density, or behavior. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Transmutation).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Transmutation—altering aura properties, changing material states, or transforming Nen into new shapes and functions. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Conjuration).name: Developing Hatsu (Conjuration)
Developing Hatsu (Conjuration).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around conjuration and summoning. You are learning to manifest objects from pure aura—weapons, tools, or barriers that obey your will. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Conjuration).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Conjuration—summoning objects, creating weapons, or manifesting barriers from aura. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Emission).name: Developing Hatsu (Emission)
Developing Hatsu (Emission).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around emission and projection. You are learning to channel your aura outward as waves, beams, or projectiles—striking from distance or defending at range. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Emission).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Emission—projecting aura as force and energy, attacking or defending at range. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Manipulation).name: Developing Hatsu (Manipulation)
Developing Hatsu (Manipulation).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around manipulation and control. You are learning to command external forces and objects through your will—bending them to your logic and turning them against your enemies. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Manipulation).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Manipulation—controlling external objects and forces, commanding puppets or remote effects, turning enemy strength against them. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

Developing Hatsu (Specialization).name: Developing Hatsu (Specialization)
Developing Hatsu (Specialization).description: A personal Hatsu technique taking shape around specialization and the inexplicable. Your technique follows no predictable pattern—it is singular, mysterious, and uniquely yours. It may blend categories or break the hexagon's rules entirely. The form and name of your technique are yours to define; it grows and evolves with you as you push its boundaries.
Developing Hatsu (Specialization).quirk: Hatsu +1. You are developing a signature technique focused on Specialization—a Nen ability that follows no standard rules, combines categories unpredictably, or works through pure individual talent. The player names and defines the technique in play, and it grows in power and complexity alongside their character.

No Hatsu Yet.name: No Hatsu Yet
No Hatsu Yet.description: You have not yet developed a signature Hatsu technique. Your Nen remains general and unspecialized; you rely on foundational applications and raw skill rather than a personal power. In time, with focus and growth, a unique technique may crystallize.
No Hatsu Yet.quirk: No Hatsu modifier granted. You have not yet awakened or developed a personal Hatsu technique. You rely on Ten, Ren, Zetsu, and other foundational applications. A Hatsu may emerge in play as your character grows.

Rookie Hunter Applicant.name: Rookie Hunter Applicant
Rookie Hunter Applicant.description: You are an aspirant seeking the Hunter License—untested, driven, and willing to face the Exam's trials. You carry basic survival skills and battlefield awareness, though you lack the seasoning of true experience. Your endurance and willpower have been forged through training; your perception is sharp. The path ahead will test everything you believe about yourself.
Rookie Hunter Applicant.quirk: Endurance +1, Willpower +1. Skills: Survival +2, Perception +2. You are fresh, hungry, and dangerous—not yet shaped by real danger, but ready to be.

Licensed Hunter.name: Licensed Hunter
Licensed Hunter.description: You hold the Hunter's License—a badge earned through grit, cunning, and survival. You have passed the Exam and walked into the wider world. Your willpower is steel; your intellect sharp and practiced. You read people and territories with an expert's eye. The Association recognizes you; the world watches you with respect or fear.
Licensed Hunter.quirk: Willpower +2, Intellect +1. Skills: Perception +2, Tracking +2, Negotiation +1. You are fully fledged—licensed, recognized, dangerous.

Arena Fighter.name: Arena Fighter
Arena Fighter.description: You have honed your body and instincts in the brutal honesty of combat arenas. Your strength is legendary; your endurance tested by a thousand battles. You move with acrobatic grace and strike with precision. You know the rhythm of violence—the ebb, flow, and fatal moment. Victory is your habit.
Arena Fighter.quirk: Strength +2, Endurance +1. Skills: Martial Arts +3, Acrobatics +2. You are a weapons-grade combatant trained by the arena itself.

Zoldyck-Trained Assassin.name: Zoldyck-Trained Assassin
Zoldyck-Trained Assassin.description: You have been shaped by the Zoldyck family—or trained by those who survived their methods. You are a living weapon, conditioned for stealth, precision, and lethality. Poison flows through your veins and knowledge; toxins are second nature. Your agility is supernatural; your willpower unbreakable. Death is your trade, and you are excellent at it.
Zoldyck-Trained Assassin.quirk: Agility +2, Willpower +1. Skills: Assassination Techniques +3, Stealth +3, Poison resistance built into your physiology. You are a predator—efficient, cold, and nearly unstoppable in the shadows.

Mafia Community Member.name: Mafia Community Member
Mafia Community Member.description: You come from the underworld—born into a mafia family or organization. You understand the language of power, money, and calculated cruelty. Your presence commands attention; your intellect navigates the byzantine politics of organized crime. You intimidate without words; you lie with the ease of breathing. The underworld is your domain.
Mafia Community Member.quirk: Presence +2, Intellect +1. Skills: Intimidation +2, Deception +2, Gambling +2. You are politically savvy, dangerous, and connected to power that operates in shadow.

Meteor City Survivor.name: Meteor City Survivor
Meteor City Survivor.description: You hail from Meteor City—the place that doesn't exist, where the unwanted make their homes in urban ruin. You have survived by stealth, cunning, and brutal adaptability. Your endurance is forged in hardship; your agility honed by danger. You know how to vanish and how to survive where others would perish. Officially, you were never born.
Meteor City Survivor.quirk: Endurance +1, Agility +1. Skills: Survival +3, Stealth +2. Officially, this character does not exist in any record. No birth certificate, no identity, no trail—perfect for those who need to disappear.

Hunter Association Staff.name: Hunter Association Staff
Hunter Association Staff.description: You work for the Hunter Association in an official capacity—an administrator, logistics officer, or specialist handler. You understand the Association's machinery from the inside; you navigate its bureaucracy with ease. Your intellect is sharp; your presence commanding. You treat Hunters as assets and allies. Power flows through information and organizational control.
Hunter Association Staff.quirk: Intellect +2, Presence +1. Skills: Tactics +2, First Aid +1, Negotiation +2. You are politically connected and understood the Association's true nature and scope.

Greed Island Player.name: Greed Island Player
Greed Island Player.description: You have survived on Greed Island—the legendary game where card-spells rewrite reality. You understand the economy of cards, the grammar of wishes, and the mechanics of the game's impossible physics. Your intellect is razor-sharp; your willpower unshakeable. Few who enter Greed Island escape; you did, and you carry its secrets.
Greed Island Player.quirk: Intellect +2, Willpower +1. Skills: Gambling +2, Tactics +2. You are fluent in the card-spell economy of Greed Island and its reality-warping mechanics. You think in terms of costs, conditions, and chains of wishes.

Kakin Court Retainer.name: Kakin Court Retainer
Kakin Court Retainer.description: You serve the royal court of Kakin—or did once. You are versed in courtly intrigue, diplomatic subtlety, and the manipulation of power through words and alliance. Your presence is refined; your intellect navigates the labyrinth of court politics. You understand succession, succession war, and the price of ambition. You are a player in games where nations are the stakes.
Kakin Court Retainer.quirk: Presence +2, Intellect +2. Skills: Negotiation +2, Deception +2, Tactics +1. You are politically savvy, courtly, and dangerous in ways that don't leave visible marks.

Chimera Ant.name: Chimera Ant
Chimera Ant.description: You are a humanoid Chimera Ant—a fusion of human and insect born from the Queen's appetite. You retain fragments of a devoured human's memories and personality, granting you intelligence and complexity that pure Ants lack. Your strength and agility are superhuman; your body a masterwork of predatory evolution. You carry an intrinsic aura—untrained, but potent. You are an aberration, and you know it.
Chimera Ant.quirk: Strength +2, Agility +2, Endurance +1. Skills: Martial Arts +2. You possess innate aura generation without formal Nen Training (your Nen tier is set narratively). You are inhuman—designed by nature and the Queen's choice to be superior to humans in every visceral way. Playable only in late-story arcs (Chimera Ant and beyond).

Civilian Prodigy.name: Civilian Prodigy
Civilian Prodigy.description: You are a untrained genius—a prodigy whose raw intellect or talent far exceeds the norm. The Hunter Association has not yet found you, or you have not yet sought them out. Your intellect is extraordinary; your presence magnetic. You carry one knowledge skill at expert level—mastery in some domain that sets you apart. The world does not know what you are capable of yet.
Civilian Prodigy.quirk: Intellect +2, Presence +1. One knowledge skill (Tactics, First Aid, Engineering, Gambling, Tracking, or Perception) gains +3. You are untrained but brilliant—dangerous precisely because you operate outside the Association's frameworks and expectations.

Kurta Survivor.name: Kurta Survivor
Kurta Survivor.description: You are one of the Kurta—or the last of them. Your eyes burn scarlet when emotion overwhelms you, marking you as prey to every Nen user who hunts your kind. You carry the weight of genocide; your willpower is tempered steel. When your eyes ignite, your concentration deepens, your perception sharpens, and you become something terrible—but you are also a walking bounty, a target for collectors and assassins.
Kurta Survivor.quirk: Willpower +2, Intellect +1. Skills: Perception +3. When your eyes turn scarlet (a state triggered by extreme emotion or voluntary focus), you gain a concentration bonus—your perception and aura control sharpen. But your scarlet eyes mark you as a Kurta, making you a target. Few know your tribe still has survivors.

Vow: Sworn Nemesis.name: Vow: Sworn Nemesis
Vow: Sworn Nemesis.description: You have sworn a vow of enmity against a single foe—a nemesis whose name is written into your very Nen. Your hatred amplifies your strength immeasurably against them; your techniques are devastatingly effective. But this focus is a cage: against anyone else, your enhanced abilities are nearly useless.
Vow: Sworn Nemesis.quirk: Ren +3, Hatsu +2 (stacking with other modifiers). This bonus applies ONLY against the sworn nemesis named at character creation. Against any other opponent, these bonuses are nullified—your hatred is so specific that it cannot be redirected. Breaking this vow (failing to challenge the nemesis, letting them live when you could kill them, or forgiving them) strips the trait and cripples your aura for one story chapter.

Vow: Announce the Kill.name: Vow: Announce the Kill
Vow: Announce the Kill.description: You have sworn that before unleashing a killing technique, you will announce your intent aloud. This vow binds your Nen, forcing transparency and honor. Your techniques are empowered by this binding; your Hatsu gains strength from the announcement. But the cost is tactical: you cannot ambush, cannot hide your preparations, cannot catch foes unaware.
Vow: Announce the Kill.quirk: Hatsu +2 (stacking with other modifiers). You may ONLY use your most devastating Hatsu techniques after declaring your intention aloud—the enemy hears you coming. This prevents surprise kills and assassination; it makes you predictable. Breaking this vow (attempting a killing technique without announcement) strips the trait and suppresses your aura for one story chapter.

Vow: Pacifist's Edge.name: Vow: Pacifist's Edge
Vow: Pacifist's Edge.description: You have sworn never to strike first—a binding vow that channeling your Nen into defense rather than offense. Your Ten is unyielding; your Ren a protective shield. But you surrender the first move; you can only counterattack, only defend, only respond. Patience becomes your greatest weapon.
Vow: Pacifist's Edge.quirk: Ten +3, Ren +2 (stacking with other modifiers). You may NEVER strike first in any conflict—you can only defend, parry, or counterattack. If you break this vow (throwing the first blow), the trait is stripped and your aura leaks away for one story chapter, leaving you defenseless.

Vow: Stake of Lifeblood.name: Vow: Stake of Lifeblood
Vow: Stake of Lifeblood.description: You have sworn to spend your own life force to power your Nen—a vow written in blood. Your Hatsu is monumentally amplified, burning with the vitality you feed it. But each technique visibly wounds you; your health suffers as the price of power. You are spending yourself to win.
Vow: Stake of Lifeblood.quirk: Hatsu +3, but health -10 (max health is permanently reduced). When you activate Hatsu abilities, the narrator describes visible wounds—bleeding, aging, exhaustion—as the cost. Your techniques are extraordinarily powerful, but every use draws red. Breaking this vow (refusing to pay the health cost) strips the trait and temporarily cripples your aura.

Vow: Conditional Arsenal.name: Vow: Conditional Arsenal
Vow: Conditional Arsenal.description: You have sworn that your signature technique functions only under a specific condition—a time of day, a location, an emotional state, a phase of the moon. This binding constraint channels enormous power into that moment. Your aura capacity swells with the promise; your technique is unkillable when conditions are met. Outside them, it is inert.
Vow: Conditional Arsenal.quirk: Aura +40 (stacking with other modifiers). Your signature Hatsu works ONLY under a creation-named condition (e.g., 'only at night,' 'only in water,' 'only when I am afraid,' 'only against my nemesis'). Outside that condition, your technique is completely non-functional. Breaking this vow (using the technique outside the condition) strips the trait and drains 70% of your aura immediately.

Vow: Time-Boxed Power.name: Vow: Time-Boxed Power
Vow: Time-Boxed Power.description: You have sworn that your Nen functions only within a declared window—a time limit, a situation, a specific number of hours per day. This binding amplifies your power tremendously within that window; you are a god in that moment. But outside it, you are diminished, almost ordinary.
Vow: Time-Boxed Power.quirk: Ren +3, Hatsu +3 (stacking with other modifiers), but ONLY within a creation-named window of time or situation (e.g., 'one hour at dusk,' 'during monsoon,' 'when the full moon rises'). Outside that window, these bonuses are nullified—you are an ordinary Nen user. Breaking this vow (using the powered-up form outside the window) strips the trait and temporarily suppresses your aura.

Vow: Ascetic's Discipline.name: Vow: Ascetic's Discipline
Vow: Ascetic's Discipline.description: You have sworn to live as an ascetic—refusing luxury, intoxication, and indulgence. This self-denial sharpens your willpower to a knife's edge; your mind and Nen crystallize into perfect clarity. But the price is a life of hardship: you cannot accept comfort, cannot rest in ease, cannot surrender to weakness.
Vow: Ascetic's Discipline.quirk: Willpower +1, Ten +2 (stacking with other modifiers). You must refuse luxury, intoxication (alcohol, drugs, poisons that alter perception), and indulgence (fine food, soft beds, pleasures). You live simply and harshly. Breaking this vow (accepting luxury or indulgence) strips the trait and temporarily weakens your aura.

Vow: Death Before Retreat.name: Vow: Death Before Retreat
Vow: Death Before Retreat.description: You have sworn to never flee a battle once joined—a vow of total commitment. Your resolve is absolute; your Nen burns with the promise of victory or death. But you surrender all choice of retreat; you are bound to fight until the enemy falls or you do.
Vow: Death Before Retreat.quirk: Ren +2, Hatsu +2, Ten +1 (stacking with other modifiers). Once you have entered combat with an opponent, you may NEVER flee, retreat, or abandon the fight—only surrender, die, or achieve victory. Breaking this vow (fleeing a battle you've joined) strips the trait and cripples your aura for one story chapter.

Hatsu: Jajanken.name: Hatsu: Jajanken
Hatsu: Jajanken.description: Rock-paper-scissors transmutation technique that alters aura into three distinct forms—each hard, flexible, or sharp—corresponding to the hand gesture. Rock crushes, paper wraps, scissors cuts. The shape mirrors the player's choice, and Nen adheres to the winning form.
Hatsu: Jajanken.quirk: Jajanken cycles through three transmuted aura forms (Rock, Paper, Scissors) based on hand gesture. Rock is hardened and defensive. Paper is flexible and deceptive. Scissors is sharp and cutting. The form wins or loses against others using the same technique.

Hatsu: Lightning Aura.name: Hatsu: Lightning Aura
Hatsu: Lightning Aura.description: Transmutation of aura into electrical current that surges through the user's body and limbs. Lightning Palm coats the hands with destructive electricity. Thunderbolt launches concentrated bolts at distance. Godspeed surrounds the body in a lightning field that accelerates movement dramatically.
Hatsu: Lightning Aura.quirk: Lightning Aura has three manifestations: Lightning Palm (melee, electricity coats hands), Thunderbolt (ranged, electrical projectile), and Godspeed (mobility, lightning field grants explosive speed and reflexes). The Godspeed form pushes the body past normal limits and causes physical strain after extended use.

Hatsu: Chains of the Kurta.name: Hatsu: Chains of the Kurta
Hatsu: Chains of the Kurta.description: Five conjured chains materialized from aura, each bound by conditions of the Kurta vow. The chains kill Troupe members outright; against others, they wound but do not slay. Emperor Time elevates the user's perception and aura control to supernatural levels but burns lifespan with each moment of activation.
Hatsu: Chains of the Kurta.quirk: Chains of the Kurta manifests five distinct chains that can bind, strike, or kill. The vow states: chains instantly kill members of the Phantom Troupe; all other opponents are merely wounded. Emperor Time is a separate mode that enhances perception, aura control, and reflexes to inhuman levels but visibly burns the user's lifespan—aging appears on their face and body. Emperor Time cannot be sustained indefinitely without permanent consequences.

Hatsu: Remote Punch.name: Hatsu: Remote Punch
Hatsu: Remote Punch.description: Emission technique that propels aura-formed fists at range, channeling strikes from a distance. The conjured hands carry full striking force, delayed slightly by range but capable of devastating impact from far away.
Hatsu: Remote Punch.quirk: Remote Punch emits aura as distant striking hands that punch from range. The strikes maintain force proportional to distance and aura expenditure. Can be used for multiple strikes or sustained pressure.

Hatsu: Bungee Gum.name: Hatsu: Bungee Gum
Hatsu: Bungee Gum.description: Transmutation technique that gives aura the combined properties of rubber and chewing gum—flexible and adhesive simultaneously. Bungee Gum can stretch, bind, manipulate, and stick to any surface. It is both weapon and trap, tool and tether.
Hatsu: Bungee Gum.quirk: Bungee Gum has the qualities of both rubber and gum. It is endlessly flexible like rubber, infinitely sticky like gum. It adheres to anything, stretches to any distance the user maintains, and can be shaped into weapons, restraints, or tools. When released, it retracts instantly. The stickiness can be toggled.

Hatsu: Needle People.name: Hatsu: Needle People
Hatsu: Needle People.description: Conjuration and manipulation technique that creates small humanoid figures from aura-infused thread and needles. These Needle People are semi-autonomous, can be remotely piloted, and serve as spies, scouts, and infiltrators. They carry the user's will to distant places.
Hatsu: Needle People.quirk: Needle People are conjured humanoid puppets made from thread, hair, and needles. They are small, stealthy, and can be remote-controlled by the caster. Each Needle Person shares limited sensory input with the user. They are durable but not combat-capable; their strength is infiltration and surveillance. The user can inject them into a target's body to puppet them from the inside.

Hatsu: Skill Hunter.name: Hatsu: Skill Hunter
Hatsu: Skill Hunter.description: Specialization technique that allows the user to steal Nen abilities from others through a conjured book. Stolen skills are copied into the book and can be re-activated later. The vow requires specific conditions: the victim must not resist, or the user must have a complete photographic record of the ability. Stolen abilities grow weaker than originals.
Hatsu: Skill Hunter.quirk: Skill Hunter is a conjured book (Bandit's Secret) that catalogs stolen Nen techniques. To steal an ability, the user must either (1) touch the target while they execute their Hatsu, or (2) possess a complete understanding of how the ability works. Once recorded, the stolen ability can be activated by the user but is 20% less efficient than the original. The book is the repository; without it, stolen skills are lost.

Hatsu: Battōjutsu En.name: Hatsu: Battōjutsu En
Hatsu: Battōjutsu En.description: Transmutation technique that manifests a conjured sword infused with aura. The sword is drawn with explosive speed, slashes with devastating sharpness, and dissolves back into aura. A variant technique surrounds the blade in a bright En (aura field) that amplifies cutting power.
Hatsu: Battōjutsu En.quirk: Battōjutsu En materializes a transmuted sword from aura with instant draw speed. The blade cuts with devastating sharpness and can be sheathed (dismissed) instantly. The En variant surrounds the sword in a visible aura field that extends cutting reach and amplifies damage.

Hatsu: Pain Packer.name: Hatsu: Pain Packer
Hatsu: Pain Packer.description: Enhancement technique that converts physical pain into aura strength. The more damage the user takes, the more power their Hatsu accumulates. Rising Sun is the ultimate expression—a devastating blast released only after absorbing sufficient injury.
Hatsu: Pain Packer.quirk: Pain Packer stores aura proportional to damage taken. Each wound, burn, or hit increases the user's aura pool and Hatsu power. Rising Sun is a charged technique that releases all accumulated aura as a massive beam—the more pain suffered, the more devastating the blast. Using Rising Sun exhausts the stored power and leaves the user temporarily vulnerable.

Hatsu: Nen Stitches.name: Hatsu: Nen Stitches
Hatsu: Nen Stitches.description: Transmutation technique that materializes aura as strong, invisible threads. These threads can sew wounds closed, bind objects, or create traps. The threads are nearly undetectable and can support enormous weight or pressure.
Hatsu: Nen Stitches.quirk: Nen Stitches creates invisible threads from transmuted aura. The threads are extremely strong and can bind almost anything. They are used for sewing wounds, stitching materials together, or creating invisible barriers and traps. The threads are nearly impossible to detect without aura sight.

Hatsu: Ripper Cyclotron.name: Hatsu: Ripper Cyclotron
Hatsu: Ripper Cyclotron.description: Enhancement and transmutation technique that spins the user's arm at extreme velocity, generating cutting wind and rotational force. The faster the arm winds, the more powerful the strike. A fully charged cyclotron can rip through almost anything.
Hatsu: Ripper Cyclotron.quirk: Ripper Cyclotron winds the user's arm in circles at accelerating speed. The faster it spins, the more powerful the strike when released. A fully wound arm generates devastating cutting force and spinning impact. The technique requires setup time to charge but delivers overwhelming power.

Hatsu: Double Machine Gun.name: Hatsu: Double Machine Gun
Hatsu: Double Machine Gun.description: Emission technique that converts both hands into rapid-fire aura cannons. The user fires sustained barrages of aura projectiles with tremendous rate of fire. Stopping either hand stops that cannon; both hands firing simultaneously creates overwhelming suppressive fire.
Hatsu: Double Machine Gun.quirk: Double Machine Gun fires aura projectiles from both hands at rapid speed. Each hand operates independently—the user can fire both cannons or just one. Sustained fire drains aura continuously. The technique excels at area denial and overwhelming opponents with volume of fire.

Hatsu: Black Voice.name: Hatsu: Black Voice
Hatsu: Black Voice.description: Manipulation and transmutation technique using a conjured antenna embedded in the user's skull. Commands issued through the antenna remotely control a target. Autopilot mode allows the user to remotely operate a controlled target's body without active concentration.
Hatsu: Black Voice.quirk: Black Voice uses a conjured antenna to issue telepathic commands to a controlled target. The antenna must pierce the target's body to establish control. Once controlled, the target obeys commands without resistance. Autopilot mode allows the user to remote-pilot the target's body while the user's own body remains dormant and vulnerable.

Hatsu: Blinky.name: Hatsu: Blinky
Hatsu: Blinky.description: Conjuration technique that manifests an aura-formed vacuum. Blinky absorbs and stores any non-living matter touched by its opening. The absorbed material can be instantly released or deployed. The vacuum follows the user but has limited capacity.
Hatsu: Blinky.quirk: Blinky is a conjured vacuum entity (appears as a large mouth/opening) that stores non-living matter. Anything non-organic that enters its opening is absorbed and stored. The stored items can be released at will. Blinky has a storage capacity limit and operates as a semi-autonomous entity following the user.

Hatsu: Memory Bomb.name: Hatsu: Memory Bomb
Hatsu: Memory Bomb.description: Specialization technique combining psychometry and projectile creation. The user fires bullets infused with memories extracted from touched targets. When a bullet hits, it forces the victim to experience the implanted memory.
Hatsu: Memory Bomb.quirk: Memory Bomb extracts memories from a touched target and converts them into projectile ammunition. Each bullet carries a specific memory; when it strikes an opponent, the victim experiences that memory forcefully. Multiple bullets can create overwhelming sensory overload. The user retains the memories extracted; they are copied, not stolen.

Hatsu: Big Bang Impact.name: Hatsu: Big Bang Impact
Hatsu: Big Bang Impact.description: Enhancement technique that channels aura into the user's fists for devastating close-range impacts. Massive physical strength is amplified further by aura enhancement, creating explosions of force on contact.
Hatsu: Big Bang Impact.quirk: Big Bang Impact empowers the user's punches with amplified aura, creating shockwaves and explosions of concussive force on impact. The stronger the opponent, the more exciting the fight for this technique. Each punch leaves visible devastation.

Hatsu: Battle Cantabile.name: Hatsu: Battle Cantabile
Hatsu: Battle Cantabile.description: Specialization technique using music and rhythm to manipulate aura and emotions. The user plays an instrument whose notes generate powerful aura effects—some notes heal, others amplify, others disorient enemies.
Hatsu: Battle Cantabile.quirk: Battle Cantabile uses musical notation and instrument performance to generate Nen effects. Different notes produce different aura results: some heal, some amplify allied aura, some disorient enemies, some create illusory effects. The user must play the correct sequence of notes to activate effects.

Hatsu: Gallery Fake.name: Hatsu: Gallery Fake
Hatsu: Gallery Fake.description: Conjuration technique that creates perfect duplicates of existing objects by touching them. The duplicates are temporary but indistinguishable from originals. Used primarily for deception and creating false evidence.
Hatsu: Gallery Fake.quirk: Gallery Fake copies any non-living object the user touches, creating a perfect aura duplicate. The copy is temporary (lasts minutes to hours depending on size and complexity) and is indistinguishable from the original. Multiple duplicates can exist simultaneously. The technique excels at deception and misdirection.

Hatsu: Dance of the Serpent's Bite.name: Hatsu: Dance of the Serpent's Bite
Hatsu: Dance of the Serpent's Bite.description: Transmutation and conjuration technique using paper as the medium. The user conjures and manipulates paper, hardening and shaping it into blades, projectiles, and armor. Paper can be folded, hardened, or made flexible as needed.
Hatsu: Dance of the Serpent's Bite.quirk: Dance of the Serpent's Bite conjures and transmutes paper into weapons and armor. Paper can be hardened to knife-edge sharpness, folded into shields, or made into flying projectiles. The technique requires skill in origami-like folding. Paper is lighter and faster than metal but less durable.

Hatsu: Dragon Lance.name: Hatsu: Dragon Lance
Hatsu: Dragon Lance.description: Enhancement technique that shapes the user's aura into a draconic form extending from their body. The dragon-shaped aura is highly compressed and can strike from distance. The technique is limited to line-of-sight or contact range.
Hatsu: Dragon Lance.quirk: Dragon Lance manifests the user's aura as a dragon-shaped extension extending from their body. The dragon can strike at distance but is limited to the user's aura radius. It carries full striking force and can be compressed for defense or extended for offense.

Hatsu: Twin Orbs.name: Hatsu: Twin Orbs
Hatsu: Twin Orbs.description: Emission technique that materializes two aura spheres that orbit the user's body. The spheres can be launched as projectiles or used defensively as rotating barriers. They follow the user's commands with perfect precision.
Hatsu: Twin Orbs.quirk: Twin Orbs creates two spheres of concentrated aura that orbit the user. The spheres can be launched at targets, used as rotating shields, or positioned for tactical advantage. They move at the user's command and return to the user when summoned.

Hatsu: Nanika's Wish.name: Hatsu: Nanika's Wish
Hatsu: Nanika's Wish.description: Specialization technique of unknown and mysterious origin. Nanika grants wishes, but each wish comes with an escalating price—requesters must fulfill increasingly difficult tasks to earn the next wish. The mechanism and full scope of the power are never fully understood, even by the user.
Hatsu: Nanika's Wish.quirk: Nanika's Wish grants requests in exchange for tasks. The first request is trivial (a simple task). Each subsequent request requires a harder task before it is fulfilled. The exchange rate is unpredictable and grows exponentially. The user does not fully understand this power's mechanics or true scope. Wishes cannot be forced or refused; they operate on their own logic.

Hatsu: Coin Bullets.name: Hatsu: Coin Bullets
Hatsu: Coin Bullets.description: Transmutation and emission technique that converts coins into projectiles. The coins are hardened and launched with aura force. Multiple coins can be fired in patterns, and ricocheting bullets create complex attack vectors.
Hatsu: Coin Bullets.quirk: Coin Bullets transmutes coins into aura-hardened projectiles fired at speed. Multiple coins can be fired in patterns, and they can ricochet off surfaces. The technique is economical (uses coins as ammunition) and allows for complex firing patterns.

Hatsu: Rider's High.name: Hatsu: Rider's High
Hatsu: Rider's High.description: Transmutation and enhancement technique that allows the user to transform their body into a vehicle or conveyance. Others can ride the transformed user, and the technique amplifies speed and carrying capacity.
Hatsu: Rider's High.quirk: Rider's High transmutes the user's body into a rideable vehicle or conveyance (car, boat, etc.) while maintaining consciousness. Others can ride the user while transformed, and the transformation grants enhanced speed and carrying capacity. The user can revert to normal form at will.

Hatsu: 100-Type Guanyin Bodhisattva.name: Hatsu: 100-Type Guanyin Bodhisattva
Hatsu: 100-Type Guanyin Bodhisattva.description: Specialization technique that manifests a massive conjured deity form surrounding the user. The form has one hundred arms and tremendous speed. Each arm moves at extreme velocity, capable of overwhelming multiple opponents. The form is sustained meditation—the user's prayer moves the statue.
Hatsu: 100-Type Guanyin Bodhisattva.quirk: 100-Type Guanyin Bodhisattva is a massive conjured deity form (100 arms) that manifests around the user. The form's speed is supernatural—literally, each arm's speed is limited only by the user's meditation and prayer. The faster the prayer, the faster the arms move. Activation requires deep focus and maintains while meditating.

Hatsu: Cattle Bell.name: Hatsu: Cattle Bell
Hatsu: Cattle Bell.description: Specialization technique using a conjured bell whose sound creates aura-based effects. The ringing resonates with targets' aura, producing psychological and physical effects. Pitch and rhythm determine the effect.
Hatsu: Cattle Bell.quirk: Cattle Bell rings with sounds that resonate with aura. Different pitches and rhythms produce different effects—some soothe, some stimulate, some induce specific emotional or physical states. Targets with exposed or synchronized aura are more susceptible.

Hatsu: Three Monkeys.name: Hatsu: Three Monkeys
Hatsu: Three Monkeys.description: Specialization technique manifesting three monkey-like aura spirits. Each monkey represents one function: seeing, hearing, or speaking. The monkeys can be sent to scout or used to block an opponent's senses.
Hatsu: Three Monkeys.quirk: Three Monkeys creates three aura-formed spirit monkeys representing See, Hear, and Speak. Each monkey can be deployed to scout or defend. Send the See monkey to scout distant areas. Send the Hear monkey to eavesdrop. Use the Speak monkey to broadcast messages or cause confusion. The monkeys follow the user's commands.

Hatsu: Mimicry.name: Hatsu: Mimicry
Hatsu: Mimicry.description: Specialization technique that allows the user to copy Nen techniques witnessed in full. The user can execute the copied technique at full power if they understand it completely. Partial knowledge results in weaker copies.
Hatsu: Mimicry.quirk: Mimicry copies any Nen technique the user has completely witnessed and understood. The copied technique functions at full effectiveness if mastery is complete, or weakened if only partially understood. The user retains all copied techniques for later use.

Hatsu: Tiger Bite Double.name: Hatsu: Tiger Bite Double
Hatsu: Tiger Bite Double.description: Conjuration technique that creates a duplicate copy of the user through aura manipulation. The duplicate has independent will and can fight autonomously, but memory coordination is imperfect. Overusing the technique causes memory confusion and strain.
Hatsu: Tiger Bite Double.quirk: Tiger Bite Double creates an aura duplicate of the user's body with full fighting capability. The duplicate is autonomous but the user can share senses with it. However, memory coordination between original and duplicate is imperfect—memories blur after extended separation. Using the technique repeatedly causes temporary memory loss and disorientation.

Hatsu: Song of Healing.name: Hatsu: Song of Healing
Hatsu: Song of Healing.description: Specialization technique using music from a flute to generate restorative aura effects. Different melodies produce different healing results—wounds close, pain fades, illnesses are purged. The music also soothes emotions and calms violent hearts.
Hatsu: Song of Healing.quirk: Song of Healing uses flute melodies to heal wounds, cure ailments, and soothe emotions. Different songs produce different results: some heal physical wounds, some cure diseases, some calm anger or fear. The user must play the correct melody, and listeners are soothed by the music.

Hatsu: Great Haiku.name: Hatsu: Great Haiku
Hatsu: Great Haiku.description: Specialization technique where spoken or written haiku verses become temporarily true. The user declares a brief poetic phrase, and the universe bends to manifest that verse. Limited to short declarations; grand wishes require longer poetry.
Hatsu: Great Haiku.quirk: Great Haiku declares poetic verses that temporarily become true. A haiku (3 lines) affects immediate reality in a small way. Longer poems create bigger effects. The verse must be genuinely poetic and sincere; lies or forced verses fail. The effect dissipates when the poetry is no longer recited.

Hatsu: Lovely Ghostwriter.name: Hatsu: Lovely Ghostwriter
Hatsu: Lovely Ghostwriter.description: Specialization technique using automatic writing to generate prophecies about others' futures. The user enters a trance state and writes prophecies automatically. The prophecies are always accurate, but the user cannot read their own fortunes.
Hatsu: Lovely Ghostwriter.quirk: Lovely Ghostwriter uses automatic writing to prophesy others' futures. The user enters trance and writes future events automatically; the words are always accurate. However, the user cannot write or read their own prophecies—the technique refuses to reveal their own future. Prophecies take the form of written predictions that must be interpreted.

Hatsu: Cookie-chan.name: Hatsu: Cookie-chan
Hatsu: Cookie-chan.description: Specialization technique that allows the user to restore and rejuvenate others through touch and esthetician skill. Physical and emotional wounds are healed; bodies return to youthful vitality. The power is linked to the user's professional expertise in body restoration.
Hatsu: Cookie-chan.quirk: Cookie-chan allows the user to restore others' bodies and youth through touch and esthetician techniques. Wounds heal, aging reverses, ailments clear. The restoration is proportional to the user's skill and aura expenditure. The user must physically touch the target and concentrate.

Hatsu: 14 Devils.name: Hatsu: 14 Devils
Hatsu: 14 Devils.description: Emission and manipulation technique that summons fourteen conjured humanoid entities that fight autonomously under the user's control. The devils are strong individually and form a formidable team. The user commands them telepathically or through presence.
Hatsu: 14 Devils.quirk: 14 Devils summons fourteen semi-autonomous aura-formed humanoids that fight as a coordinated gang. Each devil is combat-capable; together they are overwhelming. The devils follow the user's commands telepathically or through gesture. They cannot be destroyed permanently—killed devils respawn after time.

Hatsu: Little Flower & Countdown.name: Hatsu: Little Flower & Countdown
Hatsu: Little Flower & Countdown.description: Transmutation and conjuration technique with two modes. Little Flower fires palm blasts of transmuted aura. Countdown plants aura-infused charges on targets or surfaces that detonate after a set time or when release conditions are met.
Hatsu: Little Flower & Countdown.quirk: Little Flower fires aura blasts from the palms with precise detonation. Countdown plants time-bombs of aura on targets or locations that detonate when triggered or when the timer expires. The user can set multiple Countdown charges and detonate them at will or on delay.

Hatsu: Twin Gorillas.name: Hatsu: Twin Gorillas
Hatsu: Twin Gorillas.description: Specialization technique that conjures two massive gorilla-like aura constructs. The gorillas can swap positions with targets, creating tactical repositioning. They are powerful combatants and can be commanded independently.
Hatsu: Twin Gorillas.quirk: Twin Gorillas summons two large aura-gorillas that fight and obey commands. Special ability: the gorillas can swap positions with targets (dragging them to new locations). The gorillas are durable and strong but are not invulnerable. They operate under the user's telepathic command.

Hatsu: Exorcist's Beast.name: Hatsu: Exorcist's Beast
Hatsu: Exorcist's Beast.description: Specialization technique using ritualistic summoning to call a parasitic aura-creature. The beast can be assigned to devour parasites or unwanted aura infestations in targets. The ritual requires specific conditions and preparation time.
Hatsu: Exorcist's Beast.quirk: Exorcist's Beast summons a parasitic aura-eater through ritual magic. The beast can be directed to consume parasites, diseases, or hostile aura inside targets. The summoning requires preparation time and specific ritual conditions. The beast follows commands and dissolves after completing its task.

Hatsu: Crazy Slots.name: Hatsu: Crazy Slots
Hatsu: Crazy Slots.description: Conjuration technique that manifests a randomized weapon summoned from a slot-machine-like mechanism. The user cannot choose the weapon; it is randomly generated each time. A clown-like narrator announces the result theatrically.
Hatsu: Crazy Slots.quirk: Crazy Slots conjures a random weapon from a slot-machine interface (spinning reels generate 1-9). The user cannot control or predict the weapon summoned. Each pull generates a different random weapon. A supernatural narrator announces the result. The conjured weapons are fully functional and remain until dismissed.

Hatsu: Deep Purple.name: Hatsu: Deep Purple
Hatsu: Deep Purple.description: Emission technique using a conjured pipe to create an army of semi-autonomous smoke soldiers. The smoke creatures exist within the pipe's aura-space and can be deployed for reconnaissance or combat. Storage capacity is limited by the pipe's size.
Hatsu: Deep Purple.quirk: Deep Purple manifests smoke creatures from a conjured pipe. The user creates smoke-soldiers that exist within the pipe's aura capacity. Soldiers can be deployed for scouting or combat; they dissipate if the user loses aura control. The pipe has limited storage based on its size. Managing the army requires focus.

Hatsu: Hide and Seek.name: Hatsu: Hide and Seek
Hatsu: Hide and Seek.description: Conjuration technique that creates an apartment-like aura space. The user can hide inside this portal space or place it over areas, making them invisible and inaccessible to outsiders. Entering requires knowledge of the entrance.
Hatsu: Hide and Seek.quirk: Hide and Seek creates a pocket apartment within aura space. The user can step into it or overlay it on a location. Inside the space, occupants are invisible to the outside world and cannot be attacked. The portal has an entrance that only the user can open; others cannot enter without permission.

Hatsu: Hakoware.name: Hatsu: Hakoware
Hatsu: Hakoware.description: Specialization technique that creates an aura-debt system. When activated, targets accumulate Nen debt (A.P.R.) and interest (I.R.S.). The debt grows exponentially and can bankrupt a target's aura. Debt can be paid with aura or by fulfilling specific conditions.
Hatsu: Hakoware.quirk: Hakoware imposes financial-style aura debt on targets. Targets accumulate Annual Percentage Rate (A.P.R.) interest on debt automatically. Unpaid debt grows exponentially and can completely drain aura (bankruptcy). Debt can be paid with aura or by fulfilling creator-named conditions. The system operates on supernatural finance rules.

Hatsu: Hotel Rafflesia.name: Hatsu: Hotel Rafflesia
Hatsu: Hotel Rafflesia.description: Conjuration and manipulation technique creating floating aura hands and a cage construct. The hands can grab and manipulate targets; the cage can trap or contain. A vow binds the technique: caging an arm seals its power for a time.
Hatsu: Hotel Rafflesia.quirk: Hotel Rafflesia manifests floating hands (Emission) that grab and manipulate targets, and a cage construct (Conjuration). The hands are strong and dexterous; the cage is durable. Vow: if a hand or arm is caged by an opponent's technique, that limb is sealed (cannot use Nen or full strength) until released.

Hatsu: Wink Blue.name: Hatsu: Wink Blue
Hatsu: Wink Blue.description: Specialization technique that manifests a third eye capable of seeing through solid objects and reading targets' aura. The third eye can track targets from distance and perceive hidden threats. Vision is enhanced beyond normal limits.
Hatsu: Wink Blue.quirk: Wink Blue opens a third eye with clairvoyant abilities. The eye can see through walls and barriers, read opponents' aura, and track targets seen before even at great distance. The vision is cold and emotionless. The eye can be closed or hidden but deploys at will.

Hatsu: Terpsichora.name: Hatsu: Terpsichora
Hatsu: Terpsichora.description: Specialization technique granting supernatural puppet-control and medical knowledge. Terpsichora can puppeteer others' bodies and minds, and simultaneously heal them. Doctor Blythe merges combat with restoration.
Hatsu: Terpsichora.quirk: Terpsichora is a hybrid technique: puppetry (controlling others) combined with healing. The user can puppeteer targets' bodies while simultaneously healing and restoring them. Doctor Blythe specializes in surgical-precision control and restoration of injured targets. The healing is simultaneous with puppet-control.

Hatsu: Future Sight.name: Hatsu: Future Sight
Hatsu: Future Sight.description: Specialization technique granting brief glimpses of the immediate future. While holding the breath, the user can perceive about ten seconds ahead. This vision fades the instant breath is released. The technique is extrapolative and shows likely outcomes based on current conditions.
Hatsu: Future Sight.quirk: Future Sight shows approximately ten seconds into the future while the user holds their breath. The vision displays likely outcomes based on current conditions and momentum. When breath is released, vision ceases immediately. The technique is not perfect prophecy—it shows probabilities, not certainties. Extreme changes can invalidate predictions.
